Definition: properly, to wrench, i.e. (figuratively) to subvert
BiblicalUsage: 1) to twist, pervert, distort, overturn, ruin; 1a) (Piel); 1a1) to pervert (of bribery); 1a2) to subvert, turn upside down, ruin
